originalTitle: Qualcomm to raise prices during memory crunch as chipmaker issues light earnings guidance
summary: "Cost went up, prices are going to go up," Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said in an interview.
content:
Qualcomm reported fiscal third-quarter earnings on Wednesday that were in line with analyst expectations, but it provided light guidance for current-quarter earnings on in-line revenue, blaming the ongoing supply crunch for computer parts, especially memory. Shares fell in extended trading.

Qualcomm is taking concrete measures to expand its margins going forward, CEO Cristiano Amon said in an interview, including raising prices across the board starting on September 1 for the company's chips, most of which currently go to smartphone makers, and looking for other ways to streamline the company's supply chain.

"Cost went up, prices are going to go up," Amon said.

Here's how the chipmaker did versus LSEG consensus estimates:

In the current quarter, Qualcomm said it expects adjusted earnings per share of between $2.05 to $2.25 on revenue between $9.7 billion and $10.5 billion. Analysts polled by LSEG were expecting $2.36 in adjusted earnings per share on $10.02 billion of sales.

"The semiconductor industry is experiencing a broad-based increase in input costs, across wafer fabrication, assembly, test, advanced packaging, memory and other materials," Qualcomm said in its release, although, as management noted, "revenues continue to be healthy."

The company's handsets business remains the largest slice of chip sales, although Qualcomm under Amon is looking to diversify to cars, smart glasses, and robots, and is targeting non-smartphone sales to be 60% of the company's revenues next year.

Qualcomm reported $5.1 billion in handset chip sales, which was down 20% on an annual basis, and which the company said reflected a bottoming in the China market.

Amon said that dynamics in the smartphone market had made low-end and mid-priced phones less competitive because of affordability issues. He also said that even premium Android phones, where Qualcomm is dominant, were seeing customers looking for lower prices.

"Consumer preference within the premium category is changing towards a preference to the lower end of the premium, as well to last year's phone, because of the memory price increases," Amon said.

"There's also a change in gross margin because of the high supply cost that you're all hearing about," Amon added. "It's a temporary, short-term thing we are addressing with price increases."

Qualcomm's automotive business was a bright spot. Qualcomm reported $1.59 billion in automotive sales. The company said in June that it was looking to report $10 billion in automotive revenue by 2029. It announced a chip supply deal with BMW for digital cockpit chips on Wednesday.

The company is also looking to burst into the quickly-growing market for AI data center infrastructure. Amon said the was still on track to report $5 billion in data center revenue next year. On Wednesday, Qualcomm also announced that it had completed the acquisition of Modular, a buzzy software company making programming technology for AI, and the company said it would unveil its AI software platform at a conference in August.

The company's chips for low-power industrial uses and smart glasses are reported as internet of things revenue. The unit's sales rose 9% on an annual basis to $1.83 billion in sales.

Net income during the period was $2 billion, down 25% from $2.66 billion in the year-ago period.

Qualcomm makes significant profit through its QTL division, which licenses its intellectual property for cellular connections and other chip technology to other companies. Qualcomm's QTL revenue was $1.28 billion, higher than the StreetAccount estimate of $1.26 billion.
chineseTitle: 芯片制造商发布少量盈利指引，高通将在内存紧缩期间提高价格
chineseSummary: 高通首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙在接受采访时表示：“成本上升，价格也会上涨。”
chineseContent:
高通公司周三公布的第三财季收益符合分析师预期，但它对当前季度收益的在线收入提供了少量指引，并将其归咎于计算机零部件（尤其是内存）持续的供应紧缩。股价在盘后交易中下跌。

高通首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙（Cristiano Amon）在接受采访时表示，高通正在采取具体措施扩大未来的利润率，包括从 9 月 1 日开始全面提高该公司芯片的价格（目前大部分芯片供应给智能手机制造商），并寻找其他方法来简化公司的供应链。

“成本上升，价格也会上涨，”阿蒙说。

以下是这家芯片制造商的表现与伦敦证交所共识预测的比较：

高通表示，预计本季度调整后每股收益将在 2.05 美元至 2.25 美元之间，营收将在 97 亿美元至 105 亿美元之间。伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 调查的分析师预计，调整后每股收益为 2.36 美元，销售额为 100.2 亿美元。

高通公司在其新闻稿中表示，“半导体行业在晶圆制造、组装、测试、先进封装、内存和其他材料等领域的投入成本正在经历广泛的增长”，但正如管理层指出的那样，“收入仍然保持健康”。

尽管阿蒙领导下的高通公司正在寻求向汽车、智能眼镜和机器人领域多元化发展，并计划明年非智能手机销售额占公司收入的 60%，但该公司的手机业务仍然是芯片销售的最大份额。

高通公布的手机芯片销售额为 51 亿美元，同比下降 20%，该公司表示，这反映了中国市场的触底反弹。

阿蒙表示，由于负担能力问题，智能手机市场的动态导致中低端手机的竞争力下降。他还表示，即使是高通占主导地位的高端 Android 手机，客户也在寻求更低的价格。

“由于内存价格上涨，消费者对高端手机的偏好正在转向低端高端手机以及去年的手机，”阿蒙说。

阿蒙补充道：“由于大家都听说过供应成本高昂，毛利率也发生了变化。” “这是我们通过提价来解决的暂时的、短期的问题。”

高通的汽车业务是一个亮点。高通公布的汽车销售额为 15.9 亿美元。该公司 6 月表示，计划到 2029 年实现 100 亿美元的汽车收入。周三，该公司宣布与宝马达成数字座舱芯片的芯片供应协议。

该公司还寻求进军快速增长的人工智能数据中心基础设施市场。阿蒙表示，明年数据中心收入仍有望达到 50 亿美元。周三，高通还宣布完成了对 Modular 的收购，Modular 是一家为 AI 编程技术的热门软件公司，该公司表示将在 8 月份的一次会议上推出其 AI 软件平台。

该公司的低功耗工业用途芯片和智能眼镜被报告为物联网收入。该部门的销售额同比增长 9%，达到 18.3 亿美元。

期内净利润为 20 亿美元，较去年同期的 26.6 亿美元下降 25%。

高通通过其 QTL 部门获得了可观的利润，该部门将其蜂窝连接和其他芯片技术的知识产权许可给其他公司。高通QTL营收为12.8亿美元，高于StreetAccount预估的12.6亿美元。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
